bsi.editorial_reason: The pinned Hebrew of Jeremiah 48:1 has a definite article and the common noun miśgāb ('the stronghold'), not an independently verifiable place name. Scholarly translation notes confirm that the proper-name reading is a minority conjecture, with no securely attested distinct locality. Preserve the historical ACAI identity record and its old key in reversible provenance, but remove the assertion of an attested biblical city.
